updates.summary: Updated CEG thesis
updates.rationale:
CEG's repeated 200-day review is now a different fact pattern from a week ago: the stock is still below the 200-day, but it has stabilized near $261 rather than cascading lower and the nearest forward review rung at roughly $257.9 is now close enough that the next move will be informative. On the business invalidation list: (1) no hyperscaler counterparty has restructured, cancelled, or delayed the large AI nuclear PPA; (2) no evidence that the Crane restart has slipped beyond Q1 2028; (3) no two-quarter sequence of guidance cuts tied to Calpine integration; (4) no repeal or curtailment of nuclear IRA production tax credits. None of the named invalidations has happened, so this remains a hold. What is different from prior reviews is not the business; it is that the stock has stopped accelerating down while the invalidation list still reads clean.

[Belief unchanged: The thesis is still governed by contracted nuclear demand, Crane timing, FCF delivery, and policy support — none has broken.]
